name.zh: 五大联赛之外的亚洲主教练试点
name.en: Asian head coaches beyond the big five leagues

summary.zh: 统一记录 AFC 成员协会教练在欧洲非五大顶级联赛、AFC 成年与青年国家队、亚洲顶级联赛中的一线队主教练任期。共11名教练、19段任期；15段已按声明赛事完成逐场闭环，4段因职责边界或进行中赛季未闭环而保持空值。
summary.en: A unified sample of AFC-association head coaches in non-big-five European top flights, AFC senior and youth national teams, and Asian top-flight clubs. It covers 11 coaches and 19 stints: 15 have complete match-level audits for the declared scope, while four remain null because role boundaries or ongoing seasons are not closed.

note.zh: 俱乐部一线队、成年国家队和 U 系列国家队主教练进入主统计；助教、顾问、技术总监和俱乐部青年队教练只作为履历线索。
note.en: First-team club, senior national-team, and youth national-team head coaches enter the primary sample. Assistants, advisers, technical directors, and club youth coaches remain reference-only.
